title: Policies
items: What is a provisioning policy?
An entity that defines rules for allocating capacity from a pool
A rule that controls snapshot expiration
A rule that defines replication topology
A user role for storage administrators
Provisioning Policy 定義從 Pool 配置容量時的規則，Pool 內新建的 Volume 會自動採用其容量節省方式。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7 Provisioning policies
Which roles can use a provisioning policy to define rules for volume creation?
Administrator or Security Administrator
Monitor or Copy Operator
Service only
Any user in an ownership group
Administrator 或 Security Administrator 可建立並套用 Provisioning Policy。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7
What happens to existing volumes when a provisioning policy is removed from a pool or replaced?
Their capacity savings do not change
They are converted to the new policy immediately
They are deleted
They go offline
移除或更換 Policy 不影響既有 Volume 的容量節省方式，Policy 只在建立新 Volume 或 Volume Copy 時套用。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7
Which provisioning policy option uses only the built-in capacity savings of the pool, such as self-compressing FCM drives?
None
Thin-provisioning
Compression
Deduplication
None 表示不額外使用容量節省，只依 Pool 內建功能，例如 FCM Drive 本身會自動壓縮。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7
Which optional attributes can be defined for the thin-provisioning option of a provisioning policy?
Buffer size and warning threshold
Extent size and RAID level
Cache mode and I/O group
Retention and interval
Thin-provisioning 可選擇設定 Buffer Size 與 Warning Threshold。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7
Which pools support deduplication in a provisioning policy?
Data reduction pools only
Standard pools only
Both standard and data reduction pools
Child pools only
Deduplication 只有 Data Reduction Pool 支援，可搭配 Thin 與 Compression；Standard Pool 不支援。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch7
Can the capacity savings option of an existing provisioning policy be changed?
No; create and assign a new policy instead
Yes, with chprovisioningpolicy
Yes, but only in the GUI
Yes, only when no volumes exist
Provisioning Policy 可改名，但容量節省選項不能更改；需建立新 Policy 並指派給 Pool 取代舊的。
Concept Guide Ch7
How many provisioning policies can a pool have?
Only one
Two
Four
Unlimited
一個 Provisioning Policy 可關聯多個 Pool，但一個 Pool 只能有一個 Policy。
Concept Guide Ch7
Which command converts existing volumes to the capacity savings of a new provisioning policy?
addvolumecopy
chvdisk -policy
mkprovisioningpolicy
migratevdisk
使用 `addvolumecopy` 轉換既有 Volume；搭配 -autodelete 可在新 Copy 同步後自動刪除原 Copy。
Concept Guide Ch7
Which CLI command creates a provisioning policy?
mkprovisioningpolicy
mkpolicy -type provisioning
mkmdiskgrp -policy
chprovisioning
`mkprovisioningpolicy` 建立 Provisioning Policy，再以 `mkmdiskgrp` 或 `chmdiskgrp` 加到 Pool。
Concept Guide Ch7
Where are provisioning policies configured in the management GUI?
Policies > Provisioning Policies
Pools > Properties > Advanced
Settings > System > Policies
Volumes > Create Volumes
GUI 於 Policies > Provisioning Policies 設定，再到 Pools > Pools 指派給 Pool。
Concept Guide Ch7
What is a snapshot policy?
A set of rules that controls the creation and expiration of snapshots
A rule that maps volumes to hosts
A rule that limits pool capacity
A rule that sets replication bandwidth
Snapshot Policy 是控制 Snapshot 建立與到期的規則。
Concept Guide Ch7 Snapshot policies
What are the two types of snapshot policies?
System-scoped and partition-scoped
Local and remote
Primary and secondary
Safeguarded and unsafeguarded only
Snapshot Policy 分為 System-scoped (與 Storage Partition 無關) 與 Partition-scoped (屬於特定 Partition) 兩類。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7
How many schedules can a snapshot policy have?
Up to two
Only one
Up to four
Up to ten
一個 Snapshot Policy 最多 2 個 Schedule，可分別設定不同頻率與保留期間。
簡報 S4、S5；Concept Guide Ch7
What is the minimum backup interval for a snapshot policy schedule?
60 minutes
15 minutes
1 minute
24 hours
Backup Interval 最短為 60 分鐘。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7
What is the maximum retention period for a snapshot policy schedule?
365 days
30 days
90 days
7 years
Retention Period 最長為 365 天。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7
How many snapshot policies can a volume group have?
Only one
Two
Four
Unlimited
一個 Snapshot Policy 可指派給多個 Volume Group，但一個 Volume Group 只能有一個 Policy。
簡報 S4、S5；Concept Guide Ch7
If a system-scoped snapshot policy includes two schedules, what restriction applies?
Only one schedule can be a cloud backup schedule
Both must be cloud backup schedules
Neither can be Safeguarded
Both must have the same retention
System-scoped Policy 有兩個 Schedule 時，只有一個可以是 Cloud Backup Schedule。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7
What does the predefined frequent-creation, shortest-retention snapshot policy do?
Creates snapshots every six hours and retains them for one week
Creates snapshots hourly and retains them for one day
Creates snapshots daily and retains them for one month
Creates snapshots weekly and retains them for one year
最頻繁的預設 Policy 每 6 小時建立、保留 1 週，適合常更新且關鍵的資料，例如帳戶與訂單。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch7
Which predefined snapshot policy creates snapshots monthly and retains them for one year?
The less frequent, long retention policy
The hybrid policy
The cloud snapshot only policy
The frequent, shortest retention policy
每月建立、保留 1 年的 Policy 適合不常更新但需保存的資料，例如歷史客戶資料或員工紀錄。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch7
What does the predefined cloud snapshots only policy do?
Creates cloud snapshots daily and retains them for one month
Creates cloud snapshots hourly and retains them for one week
Creates cloud snapshots weekly and retains them for one year
Copies all local snapshots to the cloud
Cloud Snapshot Only Policy 每日建立 Cloud Snapshot、保留 1 個月。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch7
What does the predefined hybrid snapshot policy do?
Local snapshots every six hours kept one week, plus daily cloud snapshots kept one month
Local snapshots daily, cloud snapshots hourly
Only Safeguarded local snapshots
Weekly local and monthly cloud snapshots
Hybrid Policy：本機每 6 小時、保留 1 週；雲端每日、保留 1 個月。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch7
Which external scheduler is mentioned as able to add and manage snapshots?
IBM Copy Services Manager
IBM Spectrum Protect Plus only
VMware SRM
Ansible Tower only
官方說明 Snapshot 也可由外部排程工具，例如 IBM Copy Services Manager 建立與管理。
Concept Guide Ch7 Note
Which feature applies to partition-scoped snapshot policies?
They are immutable after creation
They support cloud backup schedules
They can be assigned to volume groups in any partition
They must have exactly one schedule
Partition-scoped Snapshot Policy 建立後不可變，支援 1 或 2 個本機 Schedule，並與 Partition 的 Split、Merge 整合。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7 Partition-scoped snapshot policies
In HA environments, what happens when a partition-scoped snapshot policy is created or assigned?
The change is automatically replicated across both HA systems
It must be created manually on both systems
It applies only to the active management system
It is converted to a system-scoped policy
HA 環境中 Partition-scoped Policy 的建立、指派或刪除會自動同步到兩個 HA 系統。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch7
When assigning a partition-scoped snapshot policy to a volume group, what is required?
The policy and the volume group must belong to the same partition
The volume group must be in a side partition
The volume group must have no volumes
The policy must have a cloud schedule
指派時 Snapshot Policy 與 Volume Group 必須屬於同一個 Partition。
Concept Guide Ch7
Where in the GUI do you create a system-scoped snapshot policy?
Policies > Snapshot policies > Create snapshot policy
Storage partitions > View partition > Snapshot policies
Volumes > Snapshots > Schedule
Settings > Snapshots
System-scoped Policy 由 Policies > Snapshot policies 建立；Partition-scoped 則由 Storage partitions 的 View partition 建立。
Concept Guide Ch7 Assigning snapshot policies
If a monthly snapshot policy starts on 31 May, when is the next snapshot created?
30 June
1 July
31 July only
28 June
每月排程在日期不存在的月份會使用該月最後一天，因此 5/31 起的下一次為 6/30，之後是 8/31。
Concept Guide Ch7 Note
How do daylight saving changes affect snapshot schedules?
They do not affect the backup and retention intervals
Snapshots are skipped during the change
Intervals are recalculated by clock time
Schedules are suspended
日光節約時間不影響間隔，例如每日 2:00 的排程會在調整後於 1:00 建立，間隔仍維持 24 小時。
Concept Guide Ch7 Note
Why do changes to the system time or time zone not affect existing snapshot schedules?
Schedules use an internal tick-driven time delta, not clock time
Schedules are stored in UTC on the cloud
Schedules are disabled when time changes
Schedules are reset to defaults
Schedule 以內部 tick 時間差運作，不依實際時鐘，因此修改系統時間或時區不影響既有排程。
Concept Guide Ch7 Note
Which command assigns or changes the snapshot policy on an existing volume group?
chvolumegroup
mksnapshotpolicy
chsnapshotpolicy
mkvolumegroup
`mksnapshotpolicy` 建立 Policy；`mkvolumegroup` 在建立時指派；`chvolumegroup` 變更既有 Volume Group 的 Policy。
Concept Guide Ch7
If you assign a policy to a volume group that already has a policy, what happens?
The new policy replaces the existing policy
The assignment fails
Both policies apply
The old policy is kept and the new one is queued
對已有 Policy 的 Volume Group 指派新 Policy，新 Policy 會取代舊 Policy。
Concept Guide Ch7
When must a snapshot policy be specified as Safeguarded at creation?
When it has more than one schedule, and for all partition-scoped policies
Only when it uses the cloud
Only for predefined policies
Never; Safeguarded is set per snapshot
有兩個以上 Schedule 的 Policy，以及所有 Partition-scoped Policy，都必須在建立時指定為 Safeguarded。
Concept Guide Ch7
Can predefined snapshot policies be deleted?
No
Yes, with rmsnapshotpolicy
Yes, by a Security Administrator
Yes, if no volume group uses them
`rmsnapshotpolicy` 只能刪除使用者自訂 Policy，預設 Policy 不能刪除。
Concept Guide Ch7 Deleting snapshot policies
Which privilege is required to delete snapshot policies that are associated with volume groups?
Security administration privileges
Monitor privileges
Copy Operator privileges
Service privileges
刪除已關聯 Volume Group 的 Policy 需要 Security Administrator 權限。
Concept Guide Ch7
Why would you suspend snapshot policies?
To avoid capturing malicious data when source volumes are compromised during a cyberattack or disaster
To save capacity during low usage
To speed up replication
To upgrade code
遭受網路攻擊或 DR 情境時，攻擊期間的 Snapshot 可能含惡意資料，可暫停 Snapshot Policy 直到釐清受影響資料。
Concept Guide Ch7 Suspending snapshot policies
Which command suspends the snapshot policy of a volume group?
chvolumegroupsnapshotpolicy
chsnapshotpolicy -suspend
rmsnapshotpolicy
chvolumegroup -nosnapshot
以 `chvolumegroupsnapshotpolicy` 或 GUI 的 Volume groups 在 Volume Group 層級暫停；`chsystem` 可暫停系統所有 Policy。
Concept Guide Ch7
How do you fully suspend a highly available partition-scoped snapshot policy?
Run chvolumegroupsnapshotpolicy on both the active and non-active management systems
Run it once on either system
Run chsystem on the active system only
Delete and re-create the policy
HA Partition-scoped Policy 只在執行指令的系統上暫停，要完全暫停需在 Active 與 Non-active Management System 都執行。
Concept Guide Ch7
Can snapshots be used for cloning or restoring while snapshot policies are suspended?
Yes
No
Only for cloning
Only for Safeguarded snapshots
Snapshot Policy 暫停期間，仍可用既有 Snapshot 進行 Clone 或 Restore。
Concept Guide Ch7
What does a replication policy define?
How replication is configured between systems
How capacity is allocated
How snapshots expire
How hosts log in
Replication Policy 定義系統間 Replication 的設定方式，其 Topology 決定 Replication 類型。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7 Replication policies
In the management GUI, how are systems in a high availability replication policy laid out?
Location 1 is fixed on the left and location 2 on the right, regardless of replication direction
The production system is always on the left
The layout changes with replication direction
The system with more capacity is on the left
GUI 固定 Location 1 在左、Location 2 在右，不受 Replication 方向影響，方便從任一系統監控。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
Which feature is enabled by default in a high availability replication policy if both systems support it?
Highly available snapshots
Asynchronous compression
Cloud snapshots
Volume protection
兩個系統都支援時，HA Replication Policy 預設啟用 Highly Available Snapshot。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
How can local volumes that are not replicated be mapped to hosts in an HA storage partition?
Place their volume groups in a side partition associated with the storage partition
Add them to the HA partition without a policy
Use a separate host object
Use image mode volumes
不需 Replication 的本機 Volume 可放到與 Storage Partition 關聯的 Side Partition，仍可映射給該 Partition 的 Host。
Concept Guide Ch7 High availability
Which configurations can a high availability replication policy be used for?
2-site HA and 3-site (HA with DR) configurations
Only 2-site DR
Only cloud replication
Only local snapshots
HA Replication Policy 可用於 2-site HA 與 3-site (HA + DR) Configuration。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
Over which connection type is synchronous DR replication NOT supported?
TCP/IP
Fibre Channel
FC with a long-distance link
Native FC ISL
同步 DR 讓兩站點同時寫入以保持一致，但不支援透過 TCP/IP 連線。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
How does asynchronous DR replication write data?
First at the primary site, then to the secondary site with a slight delay
At both sites simultaneously
Only to the secondary site
Only when a snapshot is taken
非同步 DR 先寫主站點，再稍後複製到次站點，降低網路負載並仍滿足 RPO。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
What does asynchronous replication do automatically in bandwidth-constrained environments?
Compresses data before transmission
Switches to synchronous mode
Stops replication
Deduplicates data at the target only
Bandwidth 受限時，非同步 Replication 會自動在傳輸前壓縮資料，無需使用者設定。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
When is a 2-site disaster recovery replication policy without storage partitions used?
For volume groups not in a storage partition, such as for hosts not currently supported in a partition
For all HA configurations
Only for 3-site replication
Only for cloud snapshots
不使用 Storage Partition 的 2-site DR Policy 適用於不能使用 Partition 的環境，可為非同步或同步，並指定系統與 I/O Group。
簡報 S7；Concept Guide Ch7
Between which types of policies can you switch for a volume group in a storage partition?
Synchronous and asynchronous disaster recovery policies
HA and snapshot policies
Provisioning and snapshot policies
Local and cloud provisioning policies
在 Storage Partition 的 Volume groups 面板可為 Volume Group 新增或移除 Replication，並在同步與非同步 DR Policy 之間切換。
Concept Guide Ch7 Disaster recovery policies
Which predefined snapshot policy creates snapshots weekly and retains them for one month?
The less frequent, medium retention policy
The hybrid policy
The cloud snapshot only policy
The less frequent, long retention policy
每週建立、保留 1 個月的 Policy 適合常更新但非關鍵的應用資料。
簡報 S6；Concept Guide Ch7
